name: ChomeChome Sand o Meshiagare ♡ Koakuma Joshi to Bocchi no "Watashi"
original_name: xxサンドを召し上がれ♡小悪魔女子とぼっちの「私」
source:
The protagonist, tossed about by society's hardships, is currently "searching for themself".

One day while helping with clerical work​ at their aunt's fortune-telling parlor, two mischievous girls pay a visit. Word is they've been possessed by demons...!? How will you navigate this crisis?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13093]Novelgame[/url]]
